refnamediv.refpurpose: Get and/or set the current session module

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.errors;
A ValueError is thrown if module is "user" (case insensitive).

&reftitle.changelog;
&Version; &Description;
8.0.0
module is nullable now. A ValueError is now thrown if module is "user"; formerly, a recoverable fatal error was raised.
7.2.0
Setting the module name to "user" raises a recoverable fatal error. Formerly, the module was switched to "user", which made the next session_start fail.
7.2.0
&false; is now returned, with an E_WARNING, when module is specified and a session is active or headers have already been sent.
